{{Quote|Someone down here may have salvaged some old military wreckage, a VF-72 gunner ship or an old Y-Wing.|Tamara Ryvora, to Synara San|audio=VF72GunnerShip-SynarasScore.flac|<ref name="Synara's Score" />}}
The '''VF-72 gunner ship''' was a model of military [[gunship]] used by the [[New Republic Era|time]] of the [[New Republic]].<ref name="Synara's Score" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|8}}</ref> the [[Technician|mechanics]] [[Tamara Ryvora]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]] visited the [[Colossus loading docks|loading docks]] of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' to acquire a [[CoMar Tri-Tracker chip]] in order to repair the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station's]] [[anti-aircraft cannon]]s. While at the docks, Ryvora theorized to the [[scavenger]] [[Synara San]] that such a chip could be salvaged from a VF-72 [[gunner]] [[Starship|ship]] or a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing starfighter]] pulled from the [[ocean]]s of<ref name="Synara's Score" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Traveler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> [[Castilon]].<ref name="Synara's Score" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Tam mentions an old VF-72 gunner ship. During World War II, the VF-72 was the designation of a US Navy aviation unit.|''Bucket's List''|audio=VF72GunnerShip-BucketsList.flac|<ref name="Bucket's List">{{SWKidsYouTube|7V09izVpTWs|Bucket's List #1.8: "Synara's Score" | Star Wars Resistance|sw_url=video/buckets-list-synaras-score-star-wars-resistance|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
A VF-72 gunner ship was first mentioned in "[[Synara's Score]],"<ref name="Synara's Score" /> the eighth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[November 18]], [[2018]].<ref name="Disney release">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> The episode's corresponding ''[[Bucket's List]]'' indicated the vehicle is a reference to [[Wikipedia:VF-72|VF-72]], the designation of an aviation unit used by the [[Wikipedia:United States Navy|United States Navy]] during [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]].<ref name="Bucket's List" />
